extracted_decision.summary: Implement the approved 2026-09-22 time-display design (single shared TimeTicker singleton, 60s, lifecycle-gated, in-place visible-holder rebind, no notifyDataSetChanged, formatting stays in DateUtils); do not re-plan without cause; add NO new dependency.
extracted_decision.rationale: Investigation already settled the design; avoid churn and dependency bloat.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: One shared 60s ticker vs many wake-ups.
